name: donut-chart
title: Donut chart
description: Parts of a whole, two to five, with the total in the center and exact shares; more parts fold into "Other".

when: Shares of one total, at most five parts.

instead.when: There are many parts or they are compared, not summed.

builtIn: A "Show as table" button shows the same data as a table, which screen readers get by default.
youProvide: A title that says what the figure is.

genui.description: Shares of one total, two to five parts. More fold into Other.
